about.title: About A-L-L-A-H.COM
about.mission: A-L-L-A-H.COM is the public gate to the Empire of the Light: a coherent digital world where visitors can understand the project's purpose, encounter its stories and transmissions, discover connected spaces, and choose a meaningful next step.
about.acronym: A-L-L-A-H is the project acronym: Accountable Life, Learning & Action Hub.
about.universe: MOONWITNESS XV is the story, witness, knowledge, and radio/discovery product within the Empire.
about.products: Ecosystem products: MoonWitness (stories & archive), Dock (community), Cockpit (personal workspace), Headquarter (ecosystem coordination), Moon UI (shared design language).

sources.title: Sources & Provenance
sources.methodology: Every content item carries visible provenance: source type, exact reference, edition/translator (if scripture/historical), author, date, rendering status, and verification status.
sources.scripture: Qur'an text: exact surah:ayah, edition (e.g., King Fahd Complex 1420H), translator name, rendering status (full/excerpt/paraphrase).
sources.historical: Historical/scientific data: named source, observation/model distinction, timestamp, units, uncertainty.
sources.fiction: Fictional/creative works: labeled as fiction/story universe; not claimed as external proof.
sources.rights: Copyright and licensing: original or properly licensed assets; no reproduction of copyrighted works beyond permitted limits.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.data: Data collected: authentication session (token, expiry), user preferences (theme, language, sound/motion), hosting access logs (retention unverified).
privacy.noTracking: No analytics, tracking, or client-side behavioral logging.
privacy.thirdParty: No third-party services collecting personal data.
privacy.rights: Your rights: access, correction, deletion of personal data; withdrawal of consent; complaint to supervisory authority.
privacy.contact: Contact: via About page or official project email (if available).
